name: Motion Counter — Escalate at 50 Events
description: Fires once per day when the motion_count counter reaches 50, indicating unusually high activity. Uses the counter_threshold trigger and counter condition together, escalates via Slack, and optionally chains to another rule. Pair with 7.1a to accumulate the count.

actions.message: ⚠ High motion activity on {{camera.model}} ({{camera.serial}}): {{trigger.counter_value}} motion events today as of {{time}}.
Motion count threshold reached: {{trigger.counter_value}} events on {{camera.serial}} at {{timestamp}}
